#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""pydeseq2 differential expression analysis for CBD/Cisplatin combo vs DMSO."""

import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

def main():
    counts_path = sys.argv[1]
    layout_path = sys.argv[2]
    gene_map_path = sys.argv[3]
    out_de = sys.argv[4]
    out_sig = sys.argv[5]
    out_bg = sys.argv[6]

    # --- 1. Read inputs ---
    counts_raw = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
    # The first column is unnamed in the CSV; pandas reads it as index
    # Column names are like "1_1", "1_2", ..., "10_3"
    print(f"Counts shape: {counts_raw.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

    layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path)
    # layout columns: fileNames, SampleID, Group
    print(f"Layout shape: {layout.shape}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Groups: {layout['Group'].unique()}", file=sys.stderr)

    gene_map = pd.read_csv(gene_map_path, sep='\t')
    # gene_map columns: ENSG, gene_name
    print(f"Gene map shape: {gene_map.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 2. Map column names to SampleID ---
    # Column names: "1_1", "1_2", ..., "10_3"
    # SampleID: "1-1", "1-2", ..., "10-3"
    # Convert: replace "_" with "-"
    col_to_sample = {}
    for col in counts_raw.columns:
        sample_id = col.replace('_', '-')
        col_to_sample[col] = sample_id

    # --- 3. Map SampleID to Group ---
    sample_to_group = dict(zip(layout['SampleID'], layout['Group']))
    print(f"Sample to group: {sample_to_group}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 4. Pre-filter: keep genes with counts > 10 in at least one of all 30 samples ---
    # counts_raw.shape = (n_genes, 30)
    keep = (counts_raw > 10).any(axis=1)
    counts_filtered = counts_raw.loc[keep]
    print(f"Genes after pre-filter (>10 in >=1 sample): {counts_filtered.shape[0]}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 5. Subset to 4 treatment groups ---
    target_groups = [
        'DMSO',
        'DMSO_Serum_starvation',
        'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50',
        'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'
    ]

    # Find columns belonging to target groups
    target_cols = []
    target_metadata = []
    for col in counts_filtered.columns:
        sample_id = col_to_sample[col]
        group = sample_to_group.get(sample_id)
        if group in target_groups:
            target_cols.append(col)
            target_metadata.append({'SampleID': sample_id, 'Group': group})

    counts_subset = counts_filtered[target_cols]
    metadata_df = pd.DataFrame(target_metadata, index=counts_subset.columns)
    print(f"Subset to {len(target_cols)} samples in 4 groups", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Metadata:\n{metadata_df}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 6. Run pydeseq2 ---
    # Re-filter after subsetting: remove genes with all zero counts
    nonzero = counts_subset.sum(axis=1) > 0
    counts_subset = counts_subset.loc[nonzero]
    print(f"Genes after removing all-zero in subset: {counts_subset.shape[0]}", file=sys.stderr)

    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=counts_subset,
        metadata=metadata_df,
        design="~Group",
    )
    dds.deseq2()

    # --- 7. Statistical test for contrast: Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50 vs DMSO ---
    stat_res = DeseqStats(
        dds,
        contrast=["Group", "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50", "DMSO"],
    )
    stat_res.summary()

    results = stat_res.results_df
    print(f"DE results shape: {results.shape}", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"Results columns: {results.columns.tolist()}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 8. Prepare output ---
    # Map ENSG to gene symbol
    ensg_to_symbol = dict(zip(gene_map['ENSG'], gene_map['gene_name']))

    # Add gene symbol column
    results['gene_symbol'] = results.index.map(lambda x: ensg_to_symbol.get(x, x))
    results.index.name = 'ENSG'

    # Write full DE results
    results_out = results.reset_index()
    results_out.to_csv(out_de, index=False)
    print(f"DE results written to {out_de}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 9. Filter significant DE genes ---
    sig_mask = (
        (results['padj'] <= 0.05) &
        (results['log2FoldChange'].abs() >= 0.5) &
        (results['baseMean'] >= 10)
    )
    sig_genes = results.loc[sig_mask]
    print(f"Significant DE genes: {sig_genes.shape[0]}", file=sys.stderr)

    # Write significant gene symbols (one per line, no header)
    sig_symbols = sig_genes['gene_symbol'].dropna().values
    # Remove duplicates
    sig_symbols = pd.unique(sig_symbols)
    with open(out_sig, 'w') as f:
        for g in sig_symbols:
            if g and str(g) != 'nan':
                f.write(f"{g}\n")
    print(f"Wrote {len(sig_symbols)} significant gene symbols to {out_sig}", file=sys.stderr)

    # --- 10. Background genes (all analyzed genes) ---
    # All genes in the results table (after pre-filtering and all-zero removal)
    bg_symbols = results['gene_symbol'].dropna().values
    bg_symbols = pd.unique(bg_symbols)
    with open(out_bg, 'w') as f:
        for g in bg_symbols:
            if g and str(g) != 'nan':
                f.write(f"{g}\n")
    print(f"Wrote {len(bg_symbols)} background gene symbols to {out_bg}", file=sys.stderr)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""pydeseq2 DE analysis for CBD/Cisplatin combo vs DMSO."""
import sys, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, layout_path, gene_map_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
out_de, out_sig, out_bg = sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6]

counts_raw = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path)
gene_map = pd.read_csv(gene_map_path, sep='\t')

# Map column names (1_1) to SampleID (1-1)
col_to_sample = {col: col.replace('_', '-') for col in counts_raw.columns}
sample_to_group = dict(zip(layout['SampleID'], layout['Group']))

# Pre-filter: counts > 10 in at least one of all 30 samples
keep = (counts_raw > 10).any(axis=1)
counts_filt = counts_raw.loc[keep]
print(f"After pre-filter: {counts_filt.shape[0]} genes", file=sys.stderr)

# Subset to 4 treatment groups
targets = {
    'DMSO', 'DMSO_Serum_starvation',
    'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50', 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'
}
tcols, tmeta = [], []
for col in counts_filt.columns:
    g = sample_to_group.get(col_to_sample[col])
    if g in targets:
        tcols.append(col)
        tmeta.append({'SampleID': col_to_sample[col], 'Group': g})

counts_sub = counts_filt[tcols]
meta_df = pd.DataFrame(tmeta, index=counts_sub.columns)
print(f"Subset: {len(tcols)} samples, groups: {meta_df['Group'].unique().tolist()}", file=sys.stderr)

# Remove genes with all zero counts in subset
nonzero = counts_sub.sum(axis=1) > 0
counts_sub = counts_sub.loc[nonzero]
print(f"After zero-filter in subset: {counts_sub.shape[0]} genes", file=sys.stderr)

# Run pydeseq2
dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_sub, metadata=meta_df, design="~Group")
dds.deseq2()

stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["Group", "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50", "DMSO"])
stat_res.summary()
results = stat_res.results_df
print(f"DE results: {results.shape[0]} genes, columns: {results.columns.tolist()}", file=sys.stderr)

# Map gene symbols
ensg2sym = dict(zip(gene_map['ENSG'], gene_map['gene_name']))
results['gene_symbol'] = results.index.map(lambda x: ensg2sym.get(x, x))
results.index.name = 'ENSG'

# Full DE results
results.reset_index().to_csv(out_de, index=False)

# Significant DE genes: padj <= 0.05, |lfc| >= 0.5, baseMean >= 10
sig_mask = (results['padj'] <= 0.05) & (results['log2FoldChange'].abs() >= 0.5) & (results['baseMean'] >= 10)
sig = results.loc[sig_mask]
sig_syms = pd.unique(sig['gene_symbol'].dropna().values)
with open(out_sig, 'w') as f:
    for g in sig_syms:
        if g and str(g) != 'nan':
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
print(f"Significant genes: {len(sig_syms)} symbols", file=sys.stderr)

# Background: all genes in analysis
bg_syms = pd.unique(results['gene_symbol'].dropna().values)
with open(out_bg, 'w') as f:
    for g in bg_syms:
        if g and str(g) != 'nan':
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
print(f"Background genes: {len(bg_syms)} symbols", file=sys.stderr)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""pydeseq2 DE analysis for CBD/Cisplatin combo vs DMSO."""
import sys, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, layout_path, gene_map_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
out_de, out_sig, out_bg = sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5], sys.argv[6]

counts_raw = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path)
gene_map = pd.read_csv(gene_map_path, sep='\t')

# Map column names (1_1) to SampleID (1-1)
col_to_sample = {col: col.replace('_', '-') for col in counts_raw.columns}
sample_to_group = dict(zip(layout['SampleID'], layout['Group']))

# Pre-filter: counts > 10 in at least one of all 30 samples
keep = (counts_raw > 10).any(axis=1)
counts_filt = counts_raw.loc[keep]
print(f"After pre-filter: {counts_filt.shape[0]} genes", file=sys.stderr)

# Subset to 4 treatment groups
targets = {
    'DMSO', 'DMSO_Serum_starvation',
    'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50', 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h'
}
tcols, tmeta = [], []
for col in counts_filt.columns:
    g = sample_to_group.get(col_to_sample[col])
    if g in targets:
        tcols.append(col)
        tmeta.append({'SampleID': col_to_sample[col], 'Group': g})

counts_sub = counts_filt[tcols]
meta_df = pd.DataFrame(tmeta, index=counts_sub.columns)
print(f"Subset: {len(tcols)} samples, groups: {meta_df['Group'].unique().tolist()}", file=sys.stderr)

# TRANSPOSE: pydeseq2 expects samples as rows, genes as columns
counts_sub_T = counts_sub.T

# Remove genes with all zero counts in subset
nonzero = counts_sub_T.sum(axis=0) > 0
counts_sub_T = counts_sub_T.loc[:, nonzero]
print(f"After zero-filter in subset: {counts_sub_T.shape[1]} genes", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"Count matrix shape (samples x genes): {counts_sub_T.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

# Run pydeseq2
dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts_sub_T, metadata=meta_df, design="~Group")
dds.deseq2()

stat_res = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["Group", "Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50", "DMSO"])
stat_res.summary()
results = stat_res.results_df
print(f"DE results: {results.shape[0]} genes, columns: {results.columns.tolist()}", file=sys.stderr)

# Map gene symbols
ensg2sym = dict(zip(gene_map['ENSG'], gene_map['gene_name']))
results['gene_symbol'] = results.index.map(lambda x: ensg2sym.get(x, x))
results.index.name = 'ENSG'

# Full DE results
results.reset_index().to_csv(out_de, index=False)

# Significant DE genes: padj <= 0.05, |lfc| >= 0.5, baseMean >= 10
sig_mask = (results['padj'] <= 0.05) & (results['log2FoldChange'].abs() >= 0.5) & (results['baseMean'] >= 10)
sig = results.loc[sig_mask]
sig_syms = pd.unique(sig['gene_symbol'].dropna().values)
with open(out_sig, 'w') as f:
    for g in sig_syms:
        if g and str(g) != 'nan':
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
print(f"Significant genes: {len(sig_syms)} symbols", file=sys.stderr)

# Background: all genes in analysis
bg_syms = pd.unique(results['gene_symbol'].dropna().values)
with open(out_bg, 'w') as f:
    for g in bg_syms:
        if g and str(g) != 'nan':
            f.write(f"{g}\n")
print(f"Background genes: {len(bg_syms)} symbols", file=sys.stderr)
